properties.site-address: Land adjacent and to the rear of 419-435, Cannock Road, Hednesford
properties.notes: CH/08/0165 is full planning permission for 25 flats and 2 bungalows. Application has expired. Site owner still wishes to take site forward for residential development. Site being considered for allocation as part of the Hednesford Neighbourhood Plan for retirement housing provision (potential C3 use class as independent apartments). Potential for site area to expand to adjacent land under same land ownership and for capacity to therefore increase as per Hednesford Neighbourhood Plan allocation. SHLAA site reflects previous planning consent area only at present. To keep under review in line with the emerging Hednesford Neighbourhood Plan.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
